headline: A fresh Codex usage reset has landed
originalTimeText: Brand new usage for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users
scope: All ChatGPT Work and Codex users

announcement.text:
Never slept better and feeling reseted. Brand new me and brand new usage for all ChatGPT Work and Codex users. Regaining my youth one button press at a time.

Happy Thursday

note: 原帖使用完成式措辞，明确覆盖所有 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 用户；未另行给出后台统一执行的精确时刻，因此本站只将发帖时间作为公开确认时间。
